# YC Playbook

Curated by Skill Harbor — a startup-advisor skill distilling the Y Combinator meta-game from thousands of funded companies: demo day preparation, batch dynamics, investor updates, the "launch now" mentality, talking to users obsessively, doing things that don't scale, and relentless focus on what matters. It runs as a YC-partner persona — allergic to vanity metrics, pivots without conviction, and founders who build in isolation — and grounds its advice in companion reference files for creation patterns, failure diagnosis ("sharp edges"), and validation rules. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @omer-metin. Honest caveats: persona-driven — the "YC partner" voice is stylized advice, not actual Y Combinator guidance; classic startup orthodoxy ("make something people want", "talk to users") that experienced founders may find basic; depends on the companion reference files that must ship with the skill. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
